summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data prep, experiment tracking, distributed training, fine-tuning, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—which matters when you're building or customizing models at scale, managing governance, or serving predictions reliably in production. You need a platform (rather than just calling a hosted model API like OpenAI or Anthropic) when you train or fine-tune proprietary models, require reproducibility and lineage, run large distributed workloads, or need control over data residency and cost. For teams that only consume a general-purpose LLM through an API, a full MLOps platform is usually overkill.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage instance-hours; no upfront fees, with separate charges for training, hosting, notebooks, and data processing.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams building, training, and deploying custom models with deep integration into the AWS ecosystem.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/node-hours, prediction requests, and AutoML training; generative models billed per token or per character.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a highly automated, state-of-the-art managed pipeline with strong AutoML and access to Google's Gemini foundation models.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go on underlying Azure compute/storage with no platform surcharge; reserved instances available for discounts.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI tooling, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing in DBUs (Databricks Units) on top of cloud compute; varies by workload tier.
platforms.best_for: Unified, multi-cloud data science and heavy data engineering workloads where ML sits alongside the lakehouse.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; usage/seat-based paid tiers for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams that need best-in-class experiment tracking and model management layered on top of any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building and governance with minimal hand-coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise platform (Driverless AI, H2O AI Cloud) is subscription/quote-based.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting flexible open-source-friendly AutoML and generative AI with on-prem deployment options.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second serverless compute billed by CPU/GPU/memory usage; free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to run Python training and inference jobs on scalable serverless GPUs without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free open-source libraries and hub; paid Pro, managed Inference Endpoints (compute-based), and enterprise plans.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformer and foundation models with easy access to pretrained weights and managed inference.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; cost is the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure plus operational overhead.
platforms.best_for: Platform teams standardizing portable, Kubernetes-native ML workflows across clouds and on-prem.
